limits: No images reviewed. This uses independently written report geometry and no product helper/runtime.
Cannot establish pixel arrows, port hit-area visibility, rounded outlines, glyph or complete painted bounds, model semantics, raster synchronization, performance or human approval.
Per-case inter-route crossings and overlaps remain unchanged; self-route check does not supersede those findings.
